correctness.rationale: Unit Birkhoff–James condition in real smooth ell4² is a³y1+b³y2=0; explicit orthogonal direction parameterizes boundary by continuity. Expansion gives F=1+lambda^4+6A lambda²−4sqrt(A(1−A²))lambda³ after choosing the minimizing sign, A in [0,1]. C(A) is strictly concave; L(A) increases, S(A) decreases to a unique intersection in (0,sqrt((2−sqrt3)/3)); squaring within positive branch yields Q degree eight without spurious root. Direct independent SymPy differentiation and nsolve gave A=0.1741775005401373, lambda=1.3563445784669579, mu=1.9336571846340351 and stationary residual 3.6e−15; these numeric checks corroborate rather than prove uniqueness. Endpoint objective tends 1; coordinate example gives >1, so unique stationary critical point globally maximizes.
